carpet.rule.commandEntityTracker.desc: Permission level required to use the entity tracker command
carpet.rule.commandEntityTrackerDefaultM: Default message used when entity tracker detects a valid spawn
carpet.rule.generateEmptyChunks.desc: All chunks are generated as void, with bounding boxes preserved
carpet.rule.forceSmallMap.desc: Maps are forced to be 16x16, centered on the current chunk
carpet.rule.keepInventoryXPDeletion.desc: Deletes XP on death with keep_inventory on
carpet.rule.mapGlassAlwaysTransparent.de: Map tiles are always transparent if glass is the topmost block
carpet.rule.noBarrierTeleport.desc: Prevents various entities from teleporting onto barriers
carpet.rule.noBarrierGatewayTeleport.des: Prevents entities from teleporting onto barriers when going through end gateway
carpet.rule.spearSpawnOverride.desc: Provides options to replace spear zombie held items
carpet.rule.vaultGlobalCooldown.desc: When vault rework is enabled, this overrides the default vault opening cooldown
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerGlobalCooldown.d: When vault rework is enabled, this overrides the default trial spawner spawning cooldown
carpet.rule.vaultReworkEnabled.desc: Say bye to carpet bot abuse, and say hi to op vault loot!
